name: contacts_list
title: List contacts
description: Search and filter contacts (tag, status, company, unsubscribed, sort), or `id` for one in full (tags, addresses, custom fields, recent activity). deleted: to restore. duplicates: to merge.

search.description: Matches name, email, either phone (typed any way, e.g. 647-555-1234), company name and city.

tag.description: Only contacts with this tag (name or id).

unsubscribed.description: Opted out of any / email / sms, or none.

status.description: Status name or id, or none.

duplicates.description: Groups sharing an email or phone instead.

name: contacts_manage
title: Manage contacts
description: Change contacts. create (firstName required; tags by name), update (omitted fields unchanged), delete (soft; confirm first), merge (keepId + mergeIds: duplicates folded in, then deleted; confirm), restore (ids from contacts_list deleted), bulk_update (ids + set {city, source, position, companyId, status} and/or customField).

firstName.description: Required for: create; optional for: update.

phone.description: Used by: create, update. Normalised to E.164.

phoneSecondary.description: Used by: create, update. A second number.

position.description: Used by: create, update. Job title.

source.description: Used by: create, update. Where they came from (referral, website...).

tags.description: Tag names; missing ones are created.

status.description: Used by: create, update. Status name; default if omitted.

mergeIds.description: merge: the duplicates folded into it.

ids.description: Required for: bulk_update; optional for: restore. restore: deleted ids.

deletedAt.description: restore: a deleted_at (undoes that whole delete).

set.description: bulk_update: { city?, source?, position?, companyId?, status? }.

customField.description: bulk_update: { key (field id or key), value }.

name: companies_list
title: List companies
description: Search companies, or pass `id` to fetch one in full (employees, deals, addresses, custom fields).

id.description: Company id. Returns that one company.

tag.description: Only companies with this tag (name or id).

deleted.description: List recently deleted companies instead (to restore).

name: companies_manage
title: Manage companies
description: Change companies. create (name required; tags by name), update (omitted fields unchanged; tags later: tags_manage apply), delete (soft; confirm first), restore (ids from companies_list deleted).

name.description: Required for: create; optional for: update.

website.description: Used by: create, update. Include https://.

state.description: Used by: create, update. State or province.

deletedAt.description: restore: a deleted_at (undoes that whole delete).

name: deals_list
title: List deals
description: List deals with stage, value, contact and company, or pass `id` to fetch one deal with its notes and tasks.

name: deals_manage
title: Manage deals
description: Change deals. create (title and stageId from deal_stages_list), update (stageId moves it; omitted fields unchanged; tags: tags_manage apply), delete (soft; confirm first), restore (ids from deals_list deleted).

title.description: Required for: create; optional for: update.

stageId.description: Required for: create; optional for: update.

valueCents.description: Used by: create, update. In the account's default currency (deals have no currency of their own).

closeAt.description: Used by: create, update. Expected close date, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601.

deletedAt.description: restore: a deleted_at (undoes that whole delete).

name: deal_stages_list
title: List deal stages
description: List pipelines, their stages (stage pipeline_id) and contact statuses. Call before creating or moving a deal.

name: deal_stages_manage
title: Manage deal stages
description: Pipeline stages. create (isWon / isLost mark the end stages), update (by id, or `order`: every stage id left to right), delete (deals in it need reassignTo; never the last stage; confirm first).

name.description: Required for: create; optional for: update.

color.description: Used by: create, update. Hex, e.g. "#0EA5E9".

probability.description: Used by: create, update. Win %, for the forecast.

id.description: Required for: delete; optional for: update.

reassignTo.description: delete: the stage its deals move to.

name: tasks_list
title: List tasks
description: List tasks, events and meetings (default: open, every kind), or `id` for one. Google Calendar events show as kind event. color_id: 1 Lavender, 2 Sage, 3 Grape, 4 Flamingo, 5 Banana, 6 Tangerine, 7 Peacock, 8 Graphite, 9 Blueberry, 10 Basil, 11 Tomato; null default. from+to adds repeating dates (is_virtual: no item of its own; root_id = the series).

id.description: Task id. Returns that one item.

name: tasks_manage
title: Manage tasks
description: Tasks, events and meetings (the Calendar page in the apps). create (a meeting texts the contact only with textContact: true; ask first), update (status "done" completes; contactId/companyId/dealId relink; moving a meeting re-sends its texts), delete (confirm; repeating tasks need scope; remove_from_google only if the user says).

kind.description: Used by: create, update. Default task.

title.description: Required for: create; optional for: update.

dueAt.description: Used by: create, update. ISO 8601, for tasks.

startAt.description: Used by: create, update. ISO 8601, for events/meetings.

recurrence.description: Used by: create, update. Repeats from dueAt (startAt for an event or meeting).

repeatUntil.description: Used by: create, update. Repeating: last date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no end.

isPriority.description: Used by: create, update. Starred as a priority.

textContact.description: Meetings: text the contact a confirmation and reminders. Default false.

color.description: Used by: create, update. Calendar colour, the same palette as Google Calendar; syncs both ways. "default" = the colour of its kind.

future.description: Repeating: also change every later date of the series ("this and all future"). Default: this date only.

scope.description: Repeating tasks: "occurrence" deletes this date only, "series" the whole series. A series' first task needs one of them.

remove_from_google.description: Default false. True also removes it from Google Calendar: the event, or for scope "occurrence" just that date. Only after the user confirms.

name: addresses_manage
title: Manage addresses
description: Postal addresses on a contact or company (contactId or companyId). list, create, update (omitted fields unchanged), delete (confirm first). A contact or company fetched by id already includes its addresses.

contactId.description: Used by: list, create, update, delete.

companyId.description: Used by: list, create, update, delete.

province.description: Used by: create, update. State, province or region.

is_primary.description: Used by: create, update. Make this the primary address (demotes the old one).

name: notes_list
title: List notes
description: List the notes on a contact, company or deal (pass exactly one of contactId / companyId / dealId).

name: notes_manage
title: Manage notes
description: Notes on a contact, company or deal. create (body, plus contactId / companyId / dealId), update, delete (confirm first).

name: tags_list
title: List tags
description: List the user's tags with their ids.

name: tags_manage
title: Manage tags
description: Tags. create, update (rename / recolour), delete (removes it from everyone; confirm first), apply (tagId to contactIds, companyIds and/or dealIds; remove: true takes it off). Applying a tag can start workflows listening for it.

name.description: Required for: create; optional for: update.

color.description: Used by: create, update. Hex, e.g. "#B91C1C".

remove.description: Remove the tag instead of adding it.

name: templates_list
title: List templates
description: List SMS and/or email templates (name, body, subject), or pass `id` to fetch one.

id.description: Template id. Returns that one template.

name: templates_manage
title: Manage templates
description: Saved message templates (type sms or email; email needs a subject). create, update, delete (confirm first). Merge tags: custom_fields_list with mergeTags.

name.description: Required for: create; optional for: update.

body.description: Required for: create; optional for: update.

subject.description: Used by: create, update. Email only; required there.

name: custom_fields_list
title: List custom fields
description: List custom field definitions: field_key (used in {{cf.<field_key>}}), name, type, options, entity_type. mergeTags: true lists every merge tag usable in texts, emails and workflows ({{first_name}}, {{cf.<key>}}…); unknown tags render empty.

name: custom_fields_manage
title: Manage custom fields
description: Custom fields on contacts, companies or deals. create (field_key becomes {{cf.<key>}}), update, delete (its values go too; confirm first), set_value (one record's value).

name.description: Required for: create; optional for: update. Label, e.g. "Loan amount".

options.description: Used by: create, update. Required for type select.

fieldKey.description: Required for: set_value; optional for: create. snake_case, max 60 chars.

name: sms_send
title: Send a text
description: Send a text now, or later with `scheduledAt`. Sends a real message, billed per segment on the user's own Twilio account; confirm with the user first.

scheduledAt.description: Future ISO 8601 time. Omit to send now.

contactId.description: Links the message to this contact's thread.

fromNumber.description: Sending number, E.164. Defaults to the primary.

name: sms_list
title: List texts
description: Texts. inbox: true lists conversations newest first (last message, its direction, unread count; `since` for "who texted me today"). Or the conversation with a `phone` or `contactId` (oldest first, both directions; `matched: false` if none), or `scheduled: true` for texts queued to send.

inbox.description: List conversations (the Texts inbox; campaign and bulk texts nobody answered are left out).

since.description: inbox: only conversations with a message at or after this ISO 8601 time.

phone.description: The other party's number, any format.

contactId.description: Or the contact (their primary number is used).

name: missed_call_text
title: Missed-call text-back
description: Missed-call text-back: a text sent automatically to a caller nobody answered. get (enabled, message, the default and a preview), or set (enabled and/or message; "" = the default). Turning it on texts real callers from the user's number later, unattended; confirm with the user first.

message.description: set: the text; {{business_name}} fills in. "" = the default.

name: sms_manage
title: Manage texts
description: cancel_scheduled (a queued text, by id from sms_list scheduled), delete_thread (a whole conversation by phone or contactId; nothing is sent; confirm first).

name: suppressions_manage
title: Manage email suppressions
description: Who must not be messaged. channel email (unsubscribed / bounced addresses) or sms (numbers that texted STOP); action list, add (emails[] / phones[]) or remove (re-consents one; only with their permission). Confirm adds and removes with the user.

search.description: For list: matches the address or contact name.

phones.description: For 'add': up to 500 numbers, any format.

name: email_send
title: Send an email
description: Send a real email from the user's connected mailbox (default: the oldest one). Give bodyHtml and/or bodyText. Pass contactId so merge tags resolve and the email threads to that contact. To reply in a conversation pass inReplyTo. At most 50 recipients (to+cc+bcc); a list is a campaign. One-to-one mail ignores the campaign suppression list. Confirm with the user first.

fromEmail.description: Send-as alias registered on that mailbox; others are refused (INVALID_FROM).

scheduledSendAt.description: Future ISO 8601 time to send at.

inReplyTo.description: Reply: the message_id ("<...>") of the message answered, from email_read thread.

threadId.description: Reply: that conversation's thread_id (used if inReplyTo is not found).

name: email_draft_save
title: Save an email draft
description: Save an email to Drafts WITHOUT sending it; the user reviews and sends it from Email, Drafts in the app. Use when asked to draft or prepare an email. Give bodyText and/or bodyHtml. `id` changes an existing draft (email_read threads, folder "drafts").

id.description: Change this draft (only the fields passed). Omit for a new one.

accountId.description: Mailbox it will be sent from. Default: the oldest.

name: email_message_delete
title: Cancel or delete an unsent email
description: Cancel a scheduled email before it goes, or delete a draft or a failed send. id = latest_message_id from email_read threads (folder scheduled, drafts or outbox-failed). Sent and received mail cannot be deleted here. Confirm first.

annotations.title: Cancel or delete an unsent email

name: email_read
title: Read email
description: Read email. threads (the inbox list, filter by folder / search / account), thread (threadKey: its messages; messageId: one full body), accounts (the mailboxes and send-as addresses email_send can use). Reading does not mark anything read.

search.description: Matches subject, sender and message text.

folder.description: Default: all. scheduled = queued to send; outbox-failed = sends that failed.

account.description: Mailbox id from email_accounts_list. Default: all.

before.description: For older conversations: the `next_before` from the previous answer.

messageId.description: Fetches that message's body (slower; only when the snippet is not enough).

name: email_thread_update
title: Update an email thread
description: Mark an email conversation read or unread, or move it to inbox, sent or archive.

folder.description: move: where it goes ("inbox" also un-archives).

name: calls_list
title: List calls
description: List call history (direction, duration, voicemail transcripts), or pass `id` to fetch one call with its recording details.

id.description: Call id. Returns that one call.

voicemailOnly.description: Only calls that left a voicemail.

limit.description: Default 100. A full page may mean more.

name: phone_status
title: Phone status
description: The user's phone numbers (id, number, label, which is the default for texts and calls) and their Twilio balance as Twilio reports it (quote it; do not judge it).

name: dashboard_summary
title: Dashboard summary
description: KPI summary: contact count, open and won deals with totals, messages sent/received, plus a 30-day series. pipeline: true for open deals per stage (count and value).

name: activity_list
title: List activity
description: Recent activity, newest first: texts, calls, emails, notes, deal stage changes, task completions. Optionally scoped to one contact, company or deal.

limit.description: Default 50. A full page may mean more.

name: saved_views_list
title: List saved views
description: List saved views (named filters over contacts, companies, deals or tasks).

entityType.description: Only views for this record type.

name: saved_views_manage
title: Manage saved views
description: Saved views (named filters). create (copy filterJson's shape from saved_views_list), update (rename or change the filter), delete (the records stay).

name.description: Required for: create; optional for: update.

filterJson.description: Used by: create, update. JSON-encoded filter.

name: meeting_types_list
title: List meeting types
description: List booking meeting types (the public links people book through): name, slug, duration, availability, questions. Also says whether Google Calendar is connected, since its busy times are kept free.

name: meeting_types_manage
title: Manage meeting types
description: Booking meeting types (the public links). create (name, slug, and any of the fields update takes), update (changing slug breaks links already shared), delete (the link stops working; bookings stay; confirm first).

name.description: Required for: create; optional for: update.

slug.description: Required for: create; optional for: update.

durationMin.description: Used by: create, update. Minutes. Default 30.

bufferMin.description: Used by: create, update. Minutes kept free after each booking.

statusId.description: Used by: create, update. Contact status given to people who book (name or id, from deal_stages_list contact_statuses); "" = none.

name: meetings_book
title: Book a meeting
description: Book a contact into a meeting type. slots: open times (from/to YYYY-MM-DD optional). book: startAt (ISO) + contactId, or name with email/phone. Prefer an open slot; if the user asks, any future time works, outside hours or notice. Emails them a confirmation (texts if set up); confirm with the user first. A clash returns booked:false + conflicts; retry with allowOverlap only if the user agrees.

from.description: slots: first date, YYYY-MM-DD in the meeting type's timezone.

contactId.description: book: the contact. Their email/phone are used.

name.description: book, no contactId: who. Same-name contacts come back to ask about.

allowOverlap.description: book: over something already on the calendar.

name: workflows_list
title: List workflows
description: List workflows, plus `quiet_hours` (sends wait for them; null = any time) and `daily_limits` (and today's count; over it waits for midnight). `id` for one definition; `id` + `runs: true` for its run history (newest first, per-step results).

runs.description: With id: return run history instead.

name: workflows_manage
title: Manage workflows
description: Automations. create (a trigger and steps; active by default and then acts by itself, so confirm), update (isActive false pauses), delete (confirm first).

name.description: Required for: create; optional for: update.

isActive.description: Used by: create, update. Default true.

triggerType.description: Required for: create; optional for: update.

triggerEvent.description: Used by: create, update. Event name, or inbound webhook id.

triggerConfig.description: Used by: create, update. Scheduled only: { recurrence: one_time|hourly|daily|weekly, run_at?, time_of_day?, days_of_week?, minute_of_hour?, timezone?, audience?: { tags: [1-5 names] } }. With audience it runs once per contact carrying any tag (max 500); without, once with no contact.

condition.description: Used by: create, update. Run is skipped unless true. { all|any: [{ field, op, value }] }. Fields: entity.<column>, cf.<field_key>, trigger.event|entity_type|entity_id, trigger.payload.<key> (not payload.<key>). Ops: equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with, is_set, is_not_empty, is_empty, includes_tag, greater_than, greater_or_equal, less_than, less_or_equal, older_than_days, newer_than_days. last_contacted_at older_than_days includes never-contacted contacts.

steps.description: Required for: create; optional for: update. Ordered steps, each { id?, type, config: {...} }. Types and config: send_sms { to?, body }; send_email { to?, subject, body_html?, body_text? } (blank to = the run's contact); add_to_campaign { campaign_id } (ongoing, sending); apply_tag / remove_tag { tag_name }; create_note { body }; create_task { title, description?, due_at?, due_in_days?, kind?, location?, contact_id? }; fire_webhook { url, method?, headers?, body? }; update_field { field, value } (first_name, last_name, email, phone, position, city, source, notes, primary_phone, company_id); set_custom_field { field_key, value } ("cf." prefix optional); move_deal_stage { stage_id, deal_id? }, set_deal_value { value, deal_id? } (default: the run's deal); create_deal { title, value?, stage_id? } → deal_id; set_status { status } (name; "none" clears);delay { delay_seconds | until_time HH:MM | until_date + until_offset_days?, stop_if?: {reply?, meeting?, optout?} } (account tz; stop_if: stop if they did it meanwhile); branch { condition, then: [steps], else: [steps] }. Record steps also take entity_type/entity_id. Strings support {{first_name}}, {{trigger.event}}, {{steps.<id>.output.<key>}} (give steps an id). On 400 INVALID_WORKFLOW, fix what it lists; do not retry as is.

name: workflows_run_now
title: Run a workflow now
description: Run a workflow now on one existing record, bypassing its trigger. Its steps really execute (texts, emails, webhooks), so confirm with the user.

name: inbound_webhooks_manage
title: Manage inbound webhooks
description: Inbound webhooks: manage the URLs other services POST to (settings only; runs nothing). action list | get | create | update | delete | deliveries (the last 100 posts and what each did) | rotate_token (a new URL; the old one stops at once). create and rotate_token return the full URL with its token ONCE (tell the user). delete and rotate_token break what posts to it: confirm first.

id.description: For every action but list and create.

mappingJson.description: Stored rules for mappingMode "mapped": { "actions": [{ "event": "contact.find_or_create" (or another native event), "fields": { "<groundbase_field>": "<path.in.payload>" }, "static": { "<groundbase_field>": <literal> } }] }. Paths are dotted with optional indices ("lead.contact[0].email"); missing paths are omitted.

signingSecret.description: Optional HMAC secret (create only); senders send X-Groundbase-Signature.

name: outbound_webhooks_manage
title: Manage outbound webhooks
description: Outbound webhooks: Groundbase POSTs to a URL when subscribed events fire. action list | get | create | update | delete | deliveries (recent attempts and replies) | retry (a failed one) | test (one sample event). create needs name, url, events and returns the signing secret ONCE (tell the user). A new url gets CRM data (names, emails, phones) and emails the owner: confirm it first. Confirm delete.

id.description: For every action but list and create.

url.description: Public http(s) URL (use https: the payload is CRM data). Required on create.

events.description: Event names, or ["*"] for all: contact|company.created/updated/deleted, contact.status_changed, deal.created/updated/deleted/stage_changed/won/lost, task.created/updated/completed/deleted, note.created, tag.applied/removed, sms.sent/received/delivered/failed, call.completed, voicemail.received, email.sent/received, invoice.issued/paid/voided, payment.recorded, quote.issued/accepted/declined, form.submitted, meeting.booked/rescheduled/cancelled. Slack and Discord webhook URLs get a readable message; others get signed JSON.

name: forms_manage
title: Manage forms
description: Lead-capture forms with a public link; each submission creates or updates a contact. action: list | templates | get (id) | create (name?, templateId?) | update (id + changes) | delete (id; the link stops working; confirm) | submissions (id; latest 200).

fields.description: [{ key, label, type: text|email|phone|textarea|select|address|date|checkbox|hidden|section, required?, options? (select), default? (hidden), text? (section) }]. Keys name, first_name, last_name, email, phone fill the contact. hidden = ?<key>= on the link. Replaces the list.

tags.description: Tag names put on each new lead (max 10). Replaces the list.

createTask.description: Also make a follow-up task per submission.

style.description: Colours "#rrggbb". {} = default look. Replaces the style.

name: documents_manage
title: Manage documents
description: Documents for signing. list, get (signers, history), templates (roles, fields), send (a template; emails signers), remind (emails who is due), link (a signer's link, to share in person), text (texts it), void (cancel a waiting one), remove (a finished one). Confirm send, remind and text. Statuses: sent = waiting, completed, declined, voided.

id.description: get / remind / link / text / void / remove: the document id.

contactId.description: list: documents this contact was sent. send: who signs (one signer role).

templateId.description: send: the template. With one signer role pass contactId; with several pass signers. A role marked is_sender is the user and fills itself. Contacts need an email.

signers.description: send, several roles: { role, contactId } or { role, name, email }.

title.description: send: defaults to the template name.

message.description: send: shown in the email; defaults to the template's.

ordered.description: send: sign one after another in role order (the user last).

prefill.description: send: values for the template's "before sending" fields (role _before_sending), { fieldId: value }; {{first_name}} tags fill in.

signerId.description: remind: just this signer. link / text: required (from get).

phone.description: text: the mobile number, if the signer is not a contact with one.

name: voicemail_drops_list
title: List voicemail drops
description: List voicemail drops: name, has_audio (only drops with audio can be dropped), duration_ms, source, script_text.

name: voicemail_drops_manage
title: Manage voicemail drops
description: Voicemail drops. create (name; the user records the audio by phone in the app), update (rename), delete (confirm first). On admin accounts only, `script` makes the audio in Emma's voice, billed per character: confirm the script.

name.description: Used by: create, update. Default "Untitled drop".

script.description: Used by: create, update. Up to 2000 chars (~2 min). Inline tags like [warm], [chuckles] work.

name: voicemail_drops_drop
title: Drop a voicemail
description: Play a drop onto someone's voicemail via a real Twilio call (hangs up if a person answers), billed at Twilio voice rates on the user's account. Any country (with its code). Give contactId or toPhone. Confirm with the user first.

toPhone.description: E.164, when there is no contact.

fromNumberId.description: Twilio number id. Default: first active number.

name: campaigns_manage
title: Manage campaigns
description: Email/SMS campaigns and newsletters. Actions: list (kind=newsletter for newsletters), get, create (draft; template_id starts a newsletter from newsletter_templates), update, delete, duplicate, test_send, send_now, schedule, pause, resume, stop, add_recipients, preview_audience, newsletter_templates. send_now/schedule/resume message real people: confirm first.

id.description: Campaign id; needed for all but list, create, preview_audience.

enrolment_mode.description: 'once' (default) fixes its audience at start. 'ongoing' keeps sending until stop and takes new entrants (re-checked every 5 min).

kind.description: list filter: newsletters, or everything else.

template_id.description: create: start a newsletter from this template (newsletter_templates). name defaults to the template name.

role.description: newsletter_templates: another industry's set (e.g. real estate, mortgage, insurance). Default: the user's own.

audience_filter.description: { all: [rules], any?: [rules], include_contacts?: [ids] }. all ANDs, any ORs. Rules: {type:"all_contacts"}; {type:"tag",op:"has"|"has_not",value:name}; {type:"behavior",event:"campaign_sent"|"campaign_opened"|"campaign_clicked"|"campaign_replied"|"campaign_bounced",campaign_id,within_days?,inverse?}; {type:"custom_field",field:key,op:"equals"|"not_equals"|"contains"|"gt"|"lt",value}; {type:"last_contacted",op:"gt"|"lt",days}; {type:"status",op?:"is_not",value:[names|"none"]}. include_contacts alone = exactly those people.

content.description: Single send. Email: { subject, preheader?, from_name?, from_email?, reply_to?, blocks: [{ type, props }] }; block types text {html}, header {html, level 1-3}, image {src, alt, width}, button {text, url, bgColor?}, divider {color?}, spacer {height}. from_email: a domain verified in Resend (resend_manage domains). reply_to: a mailbox connected in Groundbase, so drip reply-exit sees replies. SMS: { body, media_urls? }. Merge tags like {{first_name}}, {{cf.<key>}} work in any string. Newsletter: content.kind 'newsletter' (one email, sent once). Extra blocks: section_header {title}; agent_card {photoUrl, name, title, phone, email, website, brokerage, note}; listing_card {imageUrl, status, price, address, beds, baths, sqft, url, buttonText}; market_stats {title, stats:[{label,value,change}], footnote}; quote {quote, author, role, avatarUrl}; footer {businessName, businessAddress, tagline, unsubText}. Refused until the footer has a business name and mailing address and no [bracketed] or $— placeholder is left; the refusal names the first.

steps.description: Drip steps (send_mode 'drip'): [{ delay_seconds, content_json, exit_on?, channel? }]. Step 0 sends at start; each later step sends delay_seconds after that recipient's previous actual send. exit_on { reply?, open?, click?, meeting?, status? } skips the rest for a contact who did that. channel overrides the campaign channel for the step.

sending_window.description: { days: [0-6, 0=Sunday], start_hour: 0-23, end_hour: 1-24 (exclusive), timezone?: IANA or 'auto' (account tz) }. Sends due outside the window wait for the next open hour. null = no restriction.

audience.description: duplicate: copy goes only to people the (sent, email) campaign reached who did not open it.

name: campaigns_analytics
title: Campaign analytics
description: Stats for one campaign (recipients, sent, delivered, unique opens/clicks, bounces, unsubscribes, replies, failures). With `recipients: true`, returns per-recipient rows instead, optionally filtered by `status`.

name: resend_manage
title: Resend connection
description: The BYO Resend connection for email campaigns, read-only. Actions: status; domains (verification state; check before choosing from_email). Connecting, disconnecting, test sends and turning on tracking are done in the app (Settings > Email).

name: sending_settings
title: Sending settings
description: Daily cap on campaign EMAILS (not SMS) per day in the account timezone. get: cap, sent_today, remaining_today, domain_caps. set: daily_email_send_cap (null = none, 0 = stop today), account-wide or, with `domain`, for one domain inside it. Over-cap recipients wait for later days. Use to warm a new domain (~20/day).

domain.description: set: bare hostname, e.g. 'example.com'. Omit for the account-wide cap.

name: invoices_list
title: List invoices
description: List invoices (filter by customer, status, text; outstanding totals per currency), or `id` for one with lines, charges and amount paid. With id: payments (ledger), creditNotes, or recurring. report: aging | revenue | tax, from/to YYYY-MM-DD.

outstanding.description: Only invoices with money still owed.

name: invoices_manage
title: Manage invoices
description: Invoices. save_draft (create, or edit by id), issue (numbers it; final), send (emails it; confirm), void, public_link (a pay link; revoke), credit_note (amount + reason; final), send_credit_note / void_credit_note (creditNoteId), recurring (frequency + nextRunDate, autoSend emails each; stop). Confirm anything final or sent.

id.description: Required for: issue, send, void, public_link, credit_note, recurring; optional for: save_draft. Edit this draft.

billingProfileId.description: Bill to this profile (billing_profiles_manage list). Default: the customer's.

currency.description: ISO 4217. Defaults from the billing profile.

lines.description: itemId (saved item) or name + unitPrice. Decimal strings. taxIds: which of the taxes apply (default all).

charges.description: Below the subtotal (shipping); negative for a discount or deposit.

taxIds.description: Which of the document taxes apply (default none).

to.description: Default: profile billing email, then the contact's email.

sendVia.description: Default: their own mailbox, then Resend, then Groundbase's address.

fromEmail.description: Send from this address: a mailbox or send-as alias (email_read accounts).

message.description: A note above the invoice in the email.

attachPdf.description: Default true; false sends the link only.

confirm_paid.description: Void even though payments or credit notes are recorded on it. Only after the user has confirmed. Default false.

taxIds.description: credit_note: which of the invoice's taxes it carries (default all).

endDate.description: recurring: YYYY-MM-DD, or omit for no end.

autoSend.description: recurring: email each copy to the customer. Confirm with the user.

name: invoice_payments_manage
title: Manage invoice payments
description: record (a payment taken outside Stripe; emails a receipt, confirm first) or reverse (paymentId; undoes a recorded payment). Card refunds are done in the app.

amount.description: Decimal string in the invoice currency.

sendVia.description: How the receipt is sent. Default: their own mailbox, then Resend, then Groundbase's address.

name: invoice_items_manage
title: Manage invoice items
description: Saved invoice items (services / products). list (with price per currency), save (create, or edit by id; prices are decimal strings), delete (invoices keep their lines).

id.description: Required for: delete; optional for: save. Edit this item.

unitPrice.description: In base currency, with its decimal places ("200.00"; JPY "15000").

prices.description: Chosen prices per currency, e.g. { "CAD": "150.00" }; others convert from base.

name: billing_profiles_manage
title: Manage billing profiles
description: Billing details on a contact or company (currency, terms, billing email, tax id). list (or contactId / companyId for one), save (create on exactly one, or edit by id), delete.

id.description: Required for: delete; optional for: save. Edit this profile.

billingEmail.description: Where invoices and receipts go, if not the contact's own address.

name: invoice_settings
title: Invoice settings
description: Invoice settings: business details and logo, payment instructions, email wording, numbering, currencies, tax rates and numbers, overdue reminders, time billing. get, or set (omitted fields unchanged; nextNumber only moves forward).

businessTaxId.description: One bare number; taxNumbers (labelled) are printed instead when set.

logoUrl.description: An https:// image address ("" removes it). Uploading a file is done in the app.

emailSubject.description: Invoice email subject; tokens {number} {business} {customer} {amount} {due}. "" = the default.

emailMessage.description: Invoice email message; same tokens. "" = the default.

currencies.description: Other currencies billed in: { "USD": "0.73" } (1 of the default currency = this many); "" fetches a rate. Replaces the list.

taxPresets.description: Saved tax rates offered on new lines: [{ name, rate ("13"), is_default? }]. Replaces the list.

taxNumbers.description: Printed tax registrations: [{ label ("GST/HST #"), number }]. Replaces the list.

reminders.description: Overdue reminders emailed to customers: { enabled, days (after due, up to 5, 1-90), before (days before due, up to 2) }. Omitted keys stay. Switching on emails customers; confirm.

timeBilling.description: Time on invoices: { rounding_minutes 0|6|10|15|30, rounding_mode up|nearest, default_rate ("90", or "" for none) }. Omitted keys stay.

name: quotes_list
title: List quotes
description: List quotes with counts per status and open value per currency, or pass `id` for one quote with lines, totals, deposit and acceptance details.

id.description: Quote id. Returns that one quote.

status.description: draft | open | accepted | declined | void | expired (open but past valid-until)

name: quotes_manage
title: Manage quotes
description: Quotes. save_draft (create, or edit by id), issue (numbers it), send (emails it with an accept link; confirm), record_outcome (accepted / declined after a conversation), convert (accepted → draft invoice), void, public_link (the accept link; revoke).

id.description: Required for: issue, send, record_outcome, convert, void, public_link; optional for: save_draft. Edit this draft.

currency.description: ISO 4217. Defaults from the billing profile.

terms.description: What the customer agrees to by accepting.

lines.description: itemId (saved item) or name + unitPrice. Decimal strings. taxIds: which of the taxes apply (default all).

charges.description: Below the subtotal (shipping); negative for a discount or deposit.

taxIds.description: Which of the document taxes apply (default none).

to.description: Default: billing email, then the contact's email.

sendVia.description: Default: their own mailbox, then Resend, then Groundbase's address.

fromEmail.description: Send from this address: a mailbox or send-as alias (email_read accounts).

acceptedByName.description: Accepted: who said yes, e.g. "Dana (by phone)".

name: time_list
title: List time entries
description: List time entries (newest first) plus the running timer and per-customer totals (default last 30 days). status "unbilled" = billable, stopped, not on a live invoice.

dealId.description: Also fills in the deal's contact and company.

limit.description: Default 50. A full page may mean more.

name: time_manage
title: Manage time entries
description: Time tracking. start (the timer, for a contact / company / deal; stops any running one), stop, log (time after the fact), update (edit an entry), delete, bill (entryIds onto a draft invoice), unbill (take one back off).

dealId.description: Used by: start, log, update. Also fills in the deal's contact and company.

billable.description: Used by: start, log, update. Default true.

rate.description: Used by: start, log, update. Hourly, decimal string.

currency.description: Used by: start, log. Default: invoicing currency.
